pullRequests.title: Document function reservation workflow
pullRequests.author: ReaperOfVeriod
pullRequests.head: docs/function-reservations
pullRequests.body:
Summary

Add repository-level agent guidance for cross-contributor function reservations.
Point to issue #112 as the reservation noticeboard and keep tools/claims.py for atomic claims within a shared checkout.
Link the guidance from the README and agent workflow docs; unignore the root AGENTS.md so it is versioned.

Validation

git diff --check passes.
Verified the documented tools/claims.py commands against its CLI.

No tests run; this change updates documentation and ignore configuration only.

pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for 41 PAL functions: 12 completed during the latest automatic-search review and 29 previously reviewed, unpublished functions rebuilt against current main. commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: Five level functions #111 added under src/overlays/shared/ were already matched in their level directories (L01_00514D38, L01_00512928, L01_0059B948, L41_004490F0, L15_004E38D8); the reviewed copies stay. For func_004F5E18 and func_004B69D0 #111's C replaces main's: both match, and #111's needs no compiler profile or flag override (main's func_004F5E18 took @ee296 and a do-while wrapper).

commits.headline: fix(pal): drop volatile and hardcoded addresses from #114's sources
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
func_00160FE8, func_0051C078, func_L00_006D4A90, func_L00_007069A0 and func_L41_00441F38 read globals through literal addresses; they now name them (extern T D_x[], read at [0]) with -mno-split-addresses and still match. func_L01_004DBA78 stores through its existing D_0021EC5C declaration, and func_00139DA0 matches without volatile.

func_001469F8 polls the 0x10002010 hardware register and matched only through a volatile cast of that address; without it the C is SIZE 100/104, so it moves to…
